name: Cream of Potato Soup
description: A rich and creamy potato soup enhanced with Campbell's soup base, leeks, and mushrooms, topped with shredded cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: Water or milk (as needed for consistency)

recipeInstructions.text: In a large pot, combine all ingredients except cheese.
Bring to a boil, stirring often, then simmer for 2 to 3 hours, adding more liquid if necessary.
Add shredded cheddar cheese during the last 30 minutes of simmering.

keywords: cream of potato soup, cheesy soup, slow-cooked soup

_similar.name: Potato Soup
_similar.description: A creamy potato soup with carrots, onions, and bacon, finished with sour cream and butter for added richness.
recipeIngredient: 1 Oxo Chicken cube dissolved in 2 cups (8 oz) water + 1 cup water

recipeInstructions.text: Cook vegetables (potatoes, carrots) in 6 cups water until tender, about 20 minutes.
Microwave onions and butter until soft, about 2 minutes.
Add the cooked onion and butter mixture to the vegetables and stir.
Make a roux by stirring flour into 1 cup water until smooth, then add to the soup.
Add more water (up to 1 more cup) to achieve desired consistency.

_similar.name: Mushroom Soup
_similar.description: A creamy mushroom soup made with sautéed mushrooms, onions, and garlic in a rich milk-based broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute butter, onion, garlic and mushrooms.
Add flour and stir together.
Add stock, sauces and milk.
Simmer until heated through (approximately 15 minutes).
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: mushroom soup, creamy soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Creamy Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy and comforting broccoli soup made with potatoes, chicken broth, and a touch of Miracle Whip for richness.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large saucepan, bring chicken broth to a boil. Add potatoes and broccoli. Simmer for 10 minutes or until tender.
Purée the mixture in a blender until smooth.
Pour the puréed mixture back into the saucepan. Using a whisk, blend in Miracle Whip and seasonings.
Heat the soup thoroughly, stirring occasionally, until warmed through. Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: creamy broccoli soup, potato soup, comforting soup

_similar.name: Cheddar Baked Potato Slices
_similar.description: Thinly sliced baking potatoes baked with cheddar cheese and a creamy mushroom soup sauce.
recipeIngredient: 4 medium baking potatoes, cut into ¼ inch slices

recipeInstructions.text: In a small bowl, combine cream of mushroom soup, paprika, and pepper.
Arrange potato slices in overlapping rows in a greased 2-quart oblong baking dish.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the potatoes.
Spoon the soup mixture evenly over the cheese.
Cover the dish with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes.
Uncover and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until potatoes are fork-tender.

_similar.keywords: baked potatoes, cheddar cheese, creamy sauce
